name: الاقتصاد
description: النمو والتضخم والسياسة النقدية والمالية العامة والتجارة والاستثمار.
guide: Macro and public life: growth, inflation, central banks and rates, budgets and taxes, jobs, trade and tariffs, government policy and regulation, defence budgets and military spending, the cost of a war to a state, security pacts between governments, public infrastructure and transport systems (airports, air-traffic control, ports, railways, roads) when the story is about the system or the public, not one company. A flight ban or an air-traffic outage is economy. NOT: a single company's results (companies), asset prices (markets).

name: الأسواق
description: الأسهم والسندات والعملات والسلع وحركة رؤوس الأموال.
guide: Price moves and flows: stock indices, bonds and yields, currencies, gold and commodities as traded assets, IPO markets, fund flows, exchanges. NOT: the oil market itself when the story is supply, OPEC or fuel (energy); one company's shares on its own news (companies).

name: الطاقة
description: النفط والغاز والكهرباء والتحول في الطاقة.
guide: Oil, gas, fuel prices, OPEC+, pipelines and tankers, electricity grids and power supply, nuclear, renewables, energy policy, exploration and drilling rights (including the maritime boundaries and treaties that decide them), attacks on energy facilities. ONLY when energy itself is the subject. NOT: aviation, airlines, airports or flight disruptions (economy or companies), shipping in general (economy), a mining or metals story (companies or markets).

name: الشركات
description: أخبار الشركات في البنوك والعقارات والنقل والصناعة والتجزئة: نتائجها وصفقاتها وقياداتها.
guide: One or a few named companies: results and guidance, deals and mergers, leadership, strikes, lawsuits and fines, product launches, an airline's or automaker's or bank's own story, sector news told through its companies. The defence industry is an industry like any other and files here: a contractor's award or procurement contract, an arms sale or export deal, shipyards and military suppliers. NOT: a technology or AI company story whose point is the technology (technology); a state's defence budget or a war's cost (economy).

name: التكنولوجيا
description: الذكاء الاصطناعي والرقائق ومراكز البيانات والأمن السيبراني والتكنولوجيا المالية.
guide: The technology economy: AI models and labs, chips and data centres, platforms and apps, software, telecoms, tech regulation, digital finance and crypto infrastructure. NOT: an ordinary company story that merely mentions software (companies); an IT failure at a public agency (economy).

name: تحليلات
description: قراءات أعمق فيما وراء الخبر: ماذا يعني، ولمن، وما السيناريوهات المقبلة.

name: مدخل إلى الاقتصاد
description: مفاهيم الاقتصاد من أولها، وقراءات في أوراق بحثية متاحة مجاناً: ما هي، وكيف تُقاس، ولماذا تهمّك.
